main_measure.name: mean 5-bar unusual move in the short direction per bet case
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 over >= 30 independent cases; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2 over >= 30 cases

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move of larger-|forecast| half minus smaller half

decided_by: t of the mean unusual move lies between -2 and 2
reading: situation taken as raw component > 0 with a negative forecast; a bet is a rise of |forecast| on the short side of >= 2 points from its lowest size since the last bet (reset to 0 when flat or long); each 5-bar grid cell's case is its first bet; the larger half is |forecast| strictly above the median, the smaller half at or below it
